name: 77373 · Spring, TX
findings: ZIP 77373 (Spring) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77373 (Spring) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77373 (Spring) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
